reserveReview.rationale: Fresh live re-read on 2026-08-23. The current HLiquity chain-295 deployment maps ActivePool to Hedera contract 0.0.6070027 / EVM address 0x00000000000000000000000000000000005c9f0b, DefaultPool to 0.0.6070041 / 0x00000000000000000000000000000000005c9f19, and StabilityPool to 0.0.6070108 / 0x00000000000000000000000000000000005c9f5c. At Hedera mainnet EVM block 99,191,362 (hash 0x4b2512e592bd21c25eb147fb173699aa1c82bcf97156cbb290b08a56029c5664; 2026-08-23 17:30:32 UTC), eth_call getETH() (selector 0x14f6c3be) returned 2,611,489.67796086 HBAR for ActivePool, 0 HBAR for DefaultPool, and 31,327.48841693 HBAR for StabilityPool. At the same block, eth_call getHCHFDebt() (selector 0x6690df1f) returned 64,019.05358754 HCHF for ActivePool and 0 HCHF for DefaultPool; eth_call getTotalHCHFDeposits() (selector 0x1985480d) returned 41,061.53705120 HCHF for StabilityPool. The official HLiquity docs state that it provides interest-free loans using HBAR collateral and that the Stability Pool repays debt from liquidated Troves; the pinned protocol source states HBAR is recorded per user but stored in aggregate pools. This is a borrow-against-collateral design, not an issuer reserve: the unchanged 100% slice is HBAR collateral in protocol pools, not custodied fiat, and no other reserve asset class is asserted.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: HLiquity single-collateral HBAR CDP design and same-block Hedera mainnet state reads from ActivePool, DefaultPool, and StabilityPool
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; current protocol state shows HBAR collateral in the named pools and HCHF debt/deposits. Per-Trove collateral ratios vary by user, liquidation state can move HBAR between pools, and aggregate coverage floats with the HBAR price.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is pooled in immutable, ownership-renounced protocol contracts rather than held by any bank or custodian, and the 2026-08-23 Hedera reads confirm current HBAR state in the named pools. Legal segregation and bankruptcy-remoteness concepts do not map onto contract custody, so those fields remain unknown; Trove-level collateral is recorded per user in the TroveManager but held in aggregate pools.
